title: Dropping graceful-fs from Metro
description: Safety review of react/metro#1676: what Metro loses without graceful-fs, checked against its source and stress-tested under a 256-fd hard limit.

title: Live ES module bindings in Metro, paid for by CallRequire
description: What a live-bindings design for Metro's ES module transform costs and saves in Hermes bytecode size, startup time and memory, with CallRequire, a runtime-defined __esModule marker and lazy re-exports.

revisions.note: Tie lazy re-exports to inline requires; with inlineRequires: false, re-exports keep the spec's eager evaluation order.

title: Lazy module definition on two phones
description: Startup time and memory with Metro's serializer.unstable_lazilyDefineModules in a 5,000-module React Native app on an iPhone 12 mini and a Galaxy A16: lower memory everywhere, no time change on iOS, and a 1–3% cost on Android when nearly every module runs at startup.

revisions.note: Explain the A16 all-screens cost: on-demand definition CPU warm, plus about 7 ms of extra IO cold from the lazy bytecode layout.

title: Where Metro's transformer spends a cold build
description: Cold-build profile of Metro's transform pipeline on Mattermost mobile: worker scaling and IPC, Babel config and per-plugin costs, the main thread, and three fixes that cut CPU 8–15% with identical output.

title: Worker threads vs child processes in Metro
description: Cold-build comparison of Metro's transform workers as worker threads or child processes on macOS, Linux and Windows: build time, CPU, memory, per-job costs, a thread-mode output bug, and what committing to either would enable.

title: Native destructuring on Hermes V1
description: On-device release benchmarks of dropping @babel/plugin-transform-destructuring for Hermes V1 (react/react-native#58965): typical-app impact, per-pattern speed, bytecode size and the tradeoffs.

revisions.note: Added a follow-up on Hermes' -Xenable-fast-destructure flag.
Added a breakdown of where the bytecode size increase comes from.

title: Which preset transforms still cost Hermes bytecode
description: Each transform @react-native/babel-preset still runs for release Hermes builds, measured for bytecode size, with runtime speed and memory checked for native u-flag regexes and async functions.

title: Removing regenerator from Hermes dev builds
description: Whether @react-native/babel-preset still needs regenerator in Hermes dev builds now that Hermes 260318099.0.2 fixed generator breakpoints: version history, a breakpoint-by-breakpoint comparison of 248 lines, and the native-generator bugs that remain.

revisions.note: Clarified why the lazy-compilation sweep on 250829098.0.16 is left out.
